classification: Offline original-frame quality diagnosis; not a final eight-case result

shared_settings.feedback: Resolved RGB / current spatial velocity alpha
shared_settings.selection: Current raw edge union camera-reprojected previous raw edge

quantitative_scope.reference_bridge: All 2400 reference-MAE observations exactly match the archived short-capture analysis

observations: Minecraft f128/f130 shows very weak and locally interrupted vertical seam in all three cases. It strengthens again in f129/f131. The neighboring f124..133 examination does not establish a visibly continuous-line restoration by 16 or 17.
Bistro f126..131 retains weak/discontinuous small chair-leg structure in all three cases. Pairwise raw crops do not establish that 16 or 17 repairs the structural defect.
Minecraft leaf/grass detail changes over f126..131 in all three cases. There is no clear visible reduction sufficient to call the remaining shimmer solved.
The direct comparison does not reveal a large, consistent quality improvement from the sampling or color-blending replacement.
The settled RGB sequences are temporally constant in all three cases. This does not establish equal spatial quality or solve moving-frame flicker.

thin_line_probe.selection: Common current-spatial x search in x966..983, fixed y578..611; background columns x-3 and x+3
thin_line_probe.units: Encoded Rec709 luma 0..255; diagnostic contrast, not visibility ground truth
thin_line_probe.interpretation_ko: 17의 평균 선 대비는 14보다 약 1.75% 높지만, 약한 선 구간의 회복이나 단절 감소가 확인된 것은 아니다. 16은 f130 최소 대비를 조금 높였으나 평균 대비는 약간 낮다.

conclusion_ko: 확실한 종합 품질 승자는 확인되지 않았다. 17은 선 평균 대비와 Bistro 변화량에서 작은 개선 경향이 있고, 16은 Minecraft 변화량이 조금 낮다. 세 구현 모두 검사한 이동 구간에서 선 약화·단절과 번쩍임 문제를 해결했다고 판정하지 않는다.
limitations: 720 frames were computed and hash-checked; direct visual inspection covers only the listed representative windows, not every frame.

Fixed screen ROIs do not track a physical object; scene content can move into or out of the region. Late Minecraft leaves/grass ROI names describe their initial content, not foliage throughout the timeline.

Farneback alignment is computed from case14 filtered output and shared across all three cases, with a 32px halo and <=1px forward/backward consistency threshold. It can be biased by temporal filtering, and is not renderer motion or absolute flicker ground truth.
Raw temporal differences include motion and blur. Residual reductions of 0.1..1.1% alone do not establish a perceptually meaningful improvement.
The line probe uses a six-frame local strip and diagnostic thresholds. Counts cannot be interpreted as whole-scene thin-line disappearance counts.
Only frames60..179 match the existing supersampled spatial reference. Its metric must not be described as a 600-frame or temporal-reference result.
GIFs are indexed-color viewing aids; calculations and visual judgments use original RGB PNGs and lossless sheets.
